'''Cartel Associate N4-T3''' was the designation of an associate of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Galactic War]]. On its final day of service before leaving the Cartel, Associate N4-T3 recovered an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] set that was later sold by the Cartel.
